description_summary: Interactive briefing of a plan file — explains reasoning, schema decisions, component choices. Use when developers need to understand a plan before approving.
should_trigger: Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
Explain the schema decisions in the plan without implementing it.
Give me a short briefing of the latest pending plan.
Explain what the completed plan phases changed and why.
Use the scratchpad to explain this plan tradeoff.
should_trigger_test: Brief me on the differences between planned and completed tasks.
Show the plan explanation before asking me to continue the briefing.
should_not_trigger: Create an implementation plan for a feature spanning API, database and clients.
Execute the tasks in this existing implementation plan.
Find the suspected N+1 queries in this Drizzle loader.
Audit the pnpm lock dependency graph for supply-chain risks.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
